description: This file defines the GatewayInboundConnection class, which manages inbound network connections for a gateway in Orleans runtime. It handles message reception, rerouting, overload detection, and connection lifecycle management.

classes.name: GatewayInboundConnection
classes.description: A sealed class managing inbound gateway connections, handling message processing, rerouting, overload detection, and connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: RecordMessageReceive
methods.description: Logs and records the reception of a message.

methods.name: RecordMessageSend
methods.description: Logs and records the sending of a message.

methods.name: OnReceivedMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, handling overload, rerouting, and message expiration.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Performs connection preamble exchange and manages connection lifecycle.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares a message for sending, ensuring it hasn't expired and setting the SendingSilo if needed.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure scenarios, logging and sending rejection if requested.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries sending a message if retry count allows, otherwise fails the message.

methods.name: LogRejectingRequestDueToOverloading
methods.description: Logs a request rejection due to overload.

methods.name: LogSiloRejectingMessage
methods.description: Logs a message rejection by the silo.

methods.name: LogSiloDroppingMessage
methods.description: Logs a message being dropped by the silo.
